Ravi (Finance): We're running a tiny pricing experiment next week (5% of long-tenured accounts). Need agreement on invoice visibility and an opt-out path.
Becca (RevOps): Can we show a comparison line on invoices? customers should be able to see 'previous unit price' vs 'experiment unit price'.
Ola (Billing): Yes — billing supports parallel line items. We'll add a zeroed-out 'legacy credit' line when grandfathering applies. Example staging invoice: ```Invoice #stg-2043
acct: UmbraCorp
line1: model_tokens (legacy @ $0.0007) qty 200000 -> $140.00
line2: model_tokens (experiment @ $0.00085) qty 200000 -> $170.00
line3: grandfather_credit -$140.00
total due: $30.00```
Marta (CS): Opt-out flow: CSM opens a request ticket and we set `experiment_exempt=true` for that acct. CS to confirm SLA for opt-out (24h).
Ravi (Finance): Decision: manual CSM opt-out only for this micro-test. Add `experiment_tag: optout_via_csm` on customer record.
